selection_rule.scan_order: The exact tasks array order in coding_workflows_multifile.json
selection_rule.choose: The first eligible task; do not compare retrieval, packing, coverage, latency, or agent outcomes
eligibility: Every reference production path has a currently supported Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript saved-source extension
repo_url and revision are pinned, preparation_patch is null, minimum_production_files is at least two, and at least two distinct reference production files are named

coding_workflows_strict.json has the same task id, corpus id, repo URL, revision, and prompt; strict_control_passed is true; seed base fails; seed reference passes; and the strict checker and shared helper have frozen SHA-256 values
The selection is committed before candidate source review, retrieval, packing, selector implementation, Requests packet outcomes, or coding-agent trials

selected.reason: First eligible manifest task after requests_response_limit

substitution_policy: Do not fall back to Starlette if Click has no complementary candidate, cannot fit the frozen budgets, or fails admission. Record that failure. Replacing Click requires a new named selection lock created before further source or outcome inspection.

claim_boundary.untouched_means: Click is untouched by the Phase 0 task-evidence selector, Requests packet outcomes, and any selector tuning performed after this lock
claim_boundary.does_not_mean: Click is not a fresh project-wide repository holdout; it is an observed development repository with existing task and checker artifacts
claim_boundary.supported_claim_if_passed: A separately selected observed codebase did not lose frozen evidence under the task-evidence selector

required_next_freeze: pinned clean Click checkout and exact tracked supported-source membership
repository-root scope with exact exclusions and implementation/test classification
source-authored evaluator-only evidence checklist and unsupported structural gaps
the same resolved control and treatment budgets used by the Requests packet gate
a no-individual-loss admission rule and deterministic replay schedule
validator, tests, artifact hashes, and chronology binding committed before selector implementation
